author: Claude Code
content: Verified by loop (attempt 1). D: Added `src/lib/indicators.ts` with pure SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, VWAP, ATR and stochastic functions. Outputs are null-padded and align 1:1 with the input. Added `src/lib/indicators.test.ts`. No UI wiring. HOW TO VERIFY: `npx vitest run src/lib/indicators.test.ts`. Typecheck and eslint on both files were clean, and all 14 test files (122 tests) passed. RISKS: Low. The new code is isolated and unused. It uses Wilder smoothing for RSI and ATR and population standard deviation for Bollinger, so values may differ slightly from other charting tools.
